findings: Pricing units seen in Uzbek price lists and OLX.uz listings: (1) per m2: carpets (gilam yuvish 10,000-20,000 so'm/m2 in regional and budget shops, 33,000-44,000 in Tashkent premium; import, wool and silk carpets cost more; express 24 h is double; at-home washing has a minimum of 20-30 m2), cleaning (klining 12,000-35,000 so'm/m2 by type: regular, general, after renovation), windows (from 15,000/m2), curtains, and almost all finishing work (kafel, shpaklyovka, bo'yoq, gipsokarton, laminat, styajka), plastic windows, banners. (2) per car class: car wash, salon cleaning, polishing and detailing are priced by class (small: Matiz/Spark/Nexia; sedan: Cobalt/Lacetti/Gentra; crossover; jeep; minivan/Damas), e.g. sedan 60,000-140,000, jeep 70,000-180,000, salon chemical 400,000-500,000, detailing 1.5-1.8 mln so'm; two-phase and three-phase wash are common package names. (3) per wheel size: shinomontaj and balansirovka by R13-R19+, per wheel or per set of 4. (4) per piece (dona) / per point (nuqta): plumbing installs (unitaz 250,000-300,000, smesitel from 130,000-160,000, rakovina from 230,000), electrical points (rozetka about 62,000 per point), sofa cleaning by seats, mattress by size, alterations. (5) per meter: pipes (35,000-45,000 so'm/m), cable, overlok, curtains, kitchen furniture (pogon metr), well drilling (by depth). (6) per call-out (chaqiruv): plumber, electrician, appliance and auto masters charge a call or diagnosis (50,000-150,000), night and urgent calls +30% or 150,000-300,000; the final price is set after inspection (price_after_inspection). (7) per hour: handyman ('muj na chas', usually minimum 2 h), loaders (gruzchik per person-hour), special machinery (ekskavator, kran, avtovishka), DJ, kortej, animator, sauna. (8) per trip (reys): cargo by vehicle (Damas, Labo, Gazel, Isuzu, Kamaz), out-of-town by km; evakuator; assenizator by tank size. (9) per session: barber, beauty, massage (30/60/90 min), lessons; per month: courses, tutoring packages, nanny. (10) per event/day: wedding photo/video (studio sessions 1.2-1.7 mln), tamada, karnay-surnay, decor; to'yxona per person. (11) per kg: osh by kg of rice (cook's service, ingredients usually from the client), laundry by kg, cake by kg, milling. (12) per sotix / hectare: plowing, sowing, combine harvesting, spraying. Most OLX listings say 'kelishilgan narx' (negotiable) or 'dan' (from): templates need a 'from' price flag and an 'after inspection/measurement' flag; many shops offer free pickup and delivery (carpets) or free call-out if repaired. Needed units: pcs, m2, m, m3, hour, day, month, car, wheel, set, point, call, trip, km, kg, page, session, lesson, event, person, room, sotix, hectare. Time-slot booking is needed for: barber and beauty (manikyur, kiprik, makiyaj), massage and sauna, car wash and detailing, tutoring and lessons, photo studio, call-out masters (santexnik, elektrik, konditsioner), cleaning, at-home carpet washing; date booking (with advance payment) for weddings and events (photo/video, tamada, to'yxona, karnay, oshpaz), moving, special machinery and field work (seasonal). Regulated (need a licence or permit, mark in the catalog): medical services at home (ukol, kapelnitsa, doctor, lab), manual therapy and hijoma, cosmetological injections, circumcision (sunnat), dentistry, veterinary, disinfection and pest control (SES), gas connection and gas meters, notarial and legal services, private kindergartens, pyrotechnics, car gas equipment (certified shops), tinting (permit for the car).
